findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 20 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: u-introduction-introduction-to-radiations-used-in-medical-phys 2, 20.1 2, 20.2 4, 20.3 8, 20.4 2, 20.5 2.

10 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering radiation in medical physics, the piezoelectric effect, ultrasound imaging, image quality factors, inner-shell transitions in heavy atoms, production of X-rays with Kα/Kβ (Eqs. 20.1-20.3), bremsstrahlung and λmin, X-ray attenuation and contrast, CT scanning and PET. Every derivation of the chapter ((K.E.)max = Ve, hf = E_L − E_K, hf = E_M − E_K, (K.E.)max = hf_max) appears in a theory answer. Numericals state their constants (h, c, e, m_e, speeds of sound) and were recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: PZT, I = I₀e^(−μx), CT uses X-rays, the garbled Kβ sentence; the printed CT dose comparisons are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
